name: [Part 1] duplicates and one-sided arrays
test:
for a,expected in [([-5,-3,-1],[1,9,25]),([0,1,2],[0,1,4]),([-2,-2,0,2],[0,4,4,4])]:
    before=a[:]
    assert sorted_squares(a)==expected
    assert a==before
print("ok")

name: [Part 2] boundary ranks and duplicates
[Part 1/2] deterministic oracle
test:
import random
rng=random.Random(12)
for _ in range(50):
    a=sorted(rng.randrange(-20,21) for _ in range(rng.randrange(1,25)))
    expected=sorted(x*x for x in a)
    assert sorted_squares(a)==expected
    k=rng.randrange(1,len(a)+1)
    assert kth_smallest_square(a,k)==expected[k-1]
print("ok")
